Senses.Explanation: Granted all that; one thing is still not settled. Baichi Xingyuan closes a furnace-opening address by conceding the traveler's hard road, Eryin Mi concedes that dull iron and sick patients still crowd the forge, Yuan'an Liao grants Huangbo's scolding its power and then presses the residue against the monk, and Wuyi Yuanlai spans lifespan measures across buddhas and worlds before asking why today is called a fortieth birthday. Yangqi Fanghui grants his hall turn its sweep and tags it with unshed common air, Chijue Daochong withholds full enforcement of his Sun-Wu statutes because law to the letter leaves no people, Liangshan Yuanguan denies his thirty-blow welcome the rank of the school vehicle, Cishou Huaishen tests two elders' accord with a shouting dissatisfied guest, Tian'an Sheng asks whether the assembly would follow even the World-Honored One into the lotus land, and Baiyun Shouduan credits the patron of Hou Creek after conceding there is nothing left to say.
